title: Scan a card
hint: Fit the card in the frame with the name clearly readable
privacy: Recognition happens on your device: the photo is never sent, only the name it reads to search the catalogue.
noCamera: This browser can't use the camera. You can upload a photo of the card instead.
cameraDenied: The camera couldn't be used (permission denied or unavailable). You can upload a photo of the card instead.
nothingRead: No readable name found: type it below or try again with more light.
noResults: No cards found with this name.
